animation.reason: Animations are not run on Linux; the state change still happens, instantly (tab reorder slide, Transform inspector transition). Visual only.

fileImporter.reason: The Qt shell presents the native file chooser when session.showsImporter is set (bridge state `showsImporter`, command `dismissImporter`).

navigationTitle.reason: Upstream hides the title (titleVisibility = .hidden); the shell titles the window from the project itself (SessionWindow setWindowTitle).

preferredColorScheme.reason: The Linux shell is always dark (Fusion with the dark palette), which is what `.dark` asks for.

sharedBackgroundVisibility.reason: macOS 26 toolbar glass; the Linux header bar is drawn by the shell without it.
